# Making Waves with Dave Roetman: South Dakota Politics

> South Dakota public policy, legislation and ballot issues, straight from the people making the decisions.

The canonical home for episodes, email, and listening is https://daveroetman.substack.com

This discovery site: https://podcast.daveroetman.com/
Podcast RSS: https://api.substack.com/feed/podcast/340173.rss

Listen:
- Substack: https://daveroetman.substack.com/podcast
- Spotify: https://open.spotify.com/show/6vdjfVIZw02gpqRo3lMIEp
- Apple Podcasts: https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/making-waves-with-dave-roetman/id1812683128
- Amazon Music: https://music.amazon.com/podcasts/caa37cbc-6b74-4c75-8cec-badeaefabcf5/making-waves-with-dave-roetman-south-dakota-politics

- Rumble: https://rumble.com/c/c-7961266
